newsitem.title: USA: Fed refrains from open market operations.
newsitem.headline: Fed refrains from open market operations.

text.p: The Federal Reserve refrained from open market operations on Monday, dealers said.
Analysts had anticipated that the Fed might add temporary reserves to the banking system via overnight system repurchase agreements but they said the Fed might also be able to refrain from action.
At the Fed's usual time for open market operations, Fed funds were trading at 5-1/2 percent, the Fed's target for the rate.
(( -- E. Freilich, North American Treasury Desk 212-859-1679))
